g.text: Title: Power module - dash + main node (root)

g.desc: Title: Power module - dash + main node (root)

g.text: Miata NA hardware - power module (JLC, built twice)

g.desc: Miata NA hardware - power module (JLC, built twice)

g.text: Embedded symbols (lib PWRMOD); generated by scripts/gen-power-module

g.desc: Embedded symbols (lib PWRMOD); generated by scripts/gen-power-module

g.text: Power module (hw/power-module) - one PCB, assembled twice by JLC: dash node and main node. docs/design-power-module.md.

g.desc: Power module (hw/power-module) - one PCB, assembled twice by JLC: dash node and main node. docs/design-power-module.md.

g.text: Input and outputs: J1 -> XF1/F1 (5 A dash, 2 A main) -> D1 SMCJ24CA -> Q1 AOD4185 -> D2 SMCJ24CA, C1 = 12V_PROT;

g.desc: Input and outputs: J1 -> XF1/F1 (5 A dash, 2 A main) -> D1 SMCJ24CA -> Q1 AOD4185 -> D2 SMCJ24CA, C1 = 12V_PROT;

g.text: RT2 -> J3 (main feed / relay coils); Q2 (EN_A, default OFF) -> RT1 -> J2 (knob VM); 12V_SENSE divider -> J5.

g.desc: RT2 -> J3 (main feed / relay coils); Q2 (EN_A, default OFF) -> RT1 -> J2 (knob VM); 12V_SENSE divider -> J5.

g.text: 3V3 buck: U1 TPS54360B always on (EN open) -> 3V3 (J5.1). 5V buck: U2 TPS54360B, EN_5V default OFF, 22 uF hold -> 5V0 (J4).

g.desc: 3V3 buck: U1 TPS54360B always on (EN open) -> 3V3 (J5.1). 5V buck: U2 TPS54360B, EN_5V default OFF, 22 uF hold -> 5V0 (J4).

g.text: Main copy: J4, J2, RT1 not fitted; EN_5V and EN_A float -> U2 and Q2 stay off (R11, R13).

g.desc: Main copy: J4, J2, RT1 not fitted; EN_5V and EN_A float -> U2 and Q2 stay off (R11, R13).

g.text: Owner-fitted through-hole parts are DNP for the JLC assembly: J1-J5, XF1, C1, RT1, RT2 (F1 is a loose blade, BOM only).

g.desc: Owner-fitted through-hole parts are DNP for the JLC assembly: J1-J5, XF1, C1, RT1, RT2 (F1 is a loose blade, BOM only).

g.text: Footprints: KiCad stock libraries + project library PWRMOD (RXEF PTC, flagged VERIFY).

g.desc: Footprints: KiCad stock libraries + project library PWRMOD (RXEF PTC, flagged VERIFY).
